en: The postcard features a monochrome photograph of a serene lakeside village with wooded hills in the background. The village, named Borgsjö, is shown across a lake with visible houses and a prominent church structure. The back contains a Swedish postage stamp, handwritten text in Swedish, and various postal markings. The face of the card has the printed inscription 'Parti från Borgsjö, Erikslund,' indicating the view is from Borgsjö in the Erikslund area.
